name: PkMultiplayer (Online Co-op)
description: Online co-op for Gold, Silver, Crystal, Red, Blue and Yellow: two players in one world over LAN, the game's Link Hub or a VPN (ZeroTier, Tailscale, Radmin, Hamachi, WireGuard). See each other walk and on the Town Map, chat (T) and emote (Y), live Gen 1 and Gen 2 story events together, catch together with timed throws, talk by voice, trade through the Cable Club (Time Capsule across Gen 1/2), have your lead Pokémon walk behind you, and fight trainers, gyms, rivals and legends as 2-vs-2 co-op doubles with touch support on mobile. Patches engine code: Gen 1 and Gen 2 only.

required_imports.name: Your Gold / Silver / Crystal ROM (optional)
required_imports.description: Optional. Gives the co-op emotes and the trainers' "!" the cartridge's own bubbles, cut from your ROM on this device; without it they are drawn ones. A Crystal ROM also lets Gold and Silver show a partner who plays as Kris as Kris (walking, on the bike and in co-op battles). The mod works either way.
